svg.title: Starfall state specimen — precise companion to the visual pitch
svg.desc: Concept design strips show shower forecast, map destination availability, practice footer, dialogue, exact scores, switch states and historical Dusk settings. All labels are illustrative current-game states. Native sizing and behavior remain unverified.
